name: Deliverable Cycle Time
description: Ch.35 §7 Flow Telemetry — time from a Deliverable's creation to its most recent recorded transition, platform-wide.

name: Quality Gate Latency
description: Ch.35 §7 Governance Telemetry — friction per gate: time from first Blocked evaluation to the eventual Pass, platform-wide.

name: Command Generation Volume
description: Ch.35 §7 Runtime Telemetry — total Commands generated, platform-wide. A count today, not yet a real time-bucketed rate (see calculation method's own comment).

name: Dispatch Latency
description: Ch.35 §7 Runtime Telemetry — time from a Command being generated to its Work Item being dispatched to a Participant.

name: Work Item Execution Duration
description: Ch.35 §7 Runtime Telemetry — time from a Work Item starting execution to completing. Near-zero today (no autonomous Participant runtime yet, execution is simulated synchronously) — see calculation method's own comment.

name: Knowledge Growth
description: Ch.35 §7 Knowledge Telemetry — Knowledge Items created, broken down by Acquisition Scope (SEU/Capability/Enterprise/Platform).

name: Evidence Generation
description: Ch.35 §7 Knowledge Telemetry — Evidence records created.

name: Rework Rate
description: Ch.35 §7 Quality Telemetry — of entities that eventually passed a Quality Gate, what share needed at least one Blocked attempt first, and how many on average.

name: Deliverable Acceptance Rate
description: Ch.35 §7 Quality Telemetry — share of Deliverables that have reached Baselined, against the full lifecycle_state distribution.
